packageRules.description: Hold getrandom at 0.2. The direct 0.2 entry turns on the js feature for the getrandom 0.2 copy that ring and rand_core also use on wasm32, and getrandom 0.3 removed that feature. A bump past 0.2 fails the Cargo.lock update and takes the whole non-major group down with it, so it waits under Pending Approval on the Dependency Dashboard instead. Vulnerability updates are not held: Renovate forces dependencyDashboardApproval off for them. Drop this rule once nothing in Cargo.lock depends on getrandom 0.2.
